Reduce Alcohol Intake
Individuals who drink three or more alcoholic beverages per day account for 5 to 7 percent of those 
diagnosed with hypertension. Two or more drinks per day can lead to an increase in blood pres­
sure. Although alcohol acts as a vasodilator, chronic alcohol ingestion is associated with increased
